Summary:
- The Comarch Betterfly API enables two-way data exchange between Comarch Betterfly and external applications (e.g., your online shop) to automate invoicing and document handling.
- Target users: businesses using non-Comarch tools that need a reliable invoicing workflow.
- Data you can exchange:
  - Import into Betterfly: product list, contractor list, payment forms, bank accounts, sales invoices, printing templates, proforma invoices.
  - Export from Betterfly: add new product, add new contractor, add sales invoice, add proforma invoice.
- How it works: practical usage and setup are described in the Help/Support page (API integration guidance available there).
- Note: The page promotes “first invoice free” and provides contact lines for invoicing and KSeF inquiries.
